name: Sunflower Microgreens
description: Sunflower Microgreens (Helianthus annuus) — a microgreen crop with a 1–2 week tray lifecycle under indoor light.

careNotes.note: Blackout/dome for 2–4 days after sowing, then expose to light.
Verified: USU Extension — covered (blackout) 3–3 days, harvest at 9–10 days.
Bottom-water only after germination to avoid flattening seedlings.
Ensure airflow to prevent damping-off in dense stands.
Cut just above soil line when first true leaves appear.

notes: Standard 10×20 in (0.19 m²) nursery tray, 2.5–5 cm of medium; no pots needed.
Sow 150–200 g of seed per 10×20 tray for a dense, uniform stand.
